name: Wallace’s Malay Archipelago faunal boundary
description: Wallace described a major geographical division between animal communities of Asian and Australasian affinity.

impact.note: One boundary finding known to naturalists, refining animal geography that others had begun, with a few direct successors in regional schemes.
